test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A police travelling at 65 km/h is chasing a thief who is 1200 m away from him and is travelling at 41 km/h. Find the time taken by the policeman to catch the thief.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the policeman = 65 km/h

Speed of the thief = 41 km/h

Distance between the policeman and the thief = 1200 m

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = Speed of the policeman - Speed of the thief

Relative speed = 65 - 41

Relative speed = 24 km/h

Convert 1200 m to km:

1200 m = 1200 / 1000 km = 1.2 km

Time taken to catch the thief = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = 1.2 km / 24 km/h

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = 1.2 / 24

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = 0.05 hours

Convert hours to minutes:

0.05 hours × 60 minutes/hour = 3 minutes

**The time taken by the policeman to catch the thief is 3 minutes.**
